messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Avoid the following food products within 1 hour of taking oral levothyroxine or the medication will not be as effective: grapefruit juice, infant soy formula, soybean flour, cottonseed meal, walnuts, and high-fiber foods. Grapefruit juice can both delay absorption and reduce the amount of levothyroxine that gets into your body.
If you eat or drink any of these regularly, tell your doctor, as your dose may need adjusting.
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "has food interaction", "infant soy formula"]

The relation 'has food interaction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's effectiveness may be compromised when consumed with the specified food or beverage.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
D. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
